problem: How many fans were left at the corner shop by noon? It was the hottest day of the year; the shop had 26 fans that morning, and 14 more were sold by noon.
follow_up_questions: In the afternoon a truck brings 10 fans. How many fans does the shop have now?

problem: Only some of the art class's 34 clay birds reached the school show: 6 slipped off the tray on the steps and broke. Anya liked the owl best. How many clay birds made it to the show?
How many cupcakes reached the party? Papa baked 34 cupcakes, but 6 slid off the plate in the car and got squashed. The party was in the park.
Only 18 boxes of old textbooks are left at the school now. A van took 47 boxes to a charity on Monday and 26 more on Tuesday. How many boxes were there before Monday?
follow_up_questions: On Wednesday teachers bring 39 new boxes. How many boxes are at the school now?

problem: How many bags of leaves were in the park's pile before Monday? A truck carried away 47 bags on Monday and 26 bags on Tuesday, leaving 18.
follow_up_questions: On Wednesday the gardeners rake up 39 new bags. How many bags are in the pile now?

problem: The bike team drank some of the 40 bottles of water Coach Inez had packed, and 13 bottles were left when they got back. How many bottles did the riders drink?
follow_up_questions: On the drive home, the riders drink 8 of the leftover bottles. How many bottles does Coach Inez have now?

problem: How many sandwiches were eaten at the beach? Uncle Dev made 40 sandwiches for the family day, and 13 were left when everyone packed up.
follow_up_questions: On the way home the cousins eat 8 of the leftover sandwiches. How many sandwiches does Uncle Dev have now?

problem: Only 11 people stayed to the end of the bird club's owl walk. It began with 28 parents and kids, but rain sent the others home early. How many people left early?
follow_up_questions: On the next dry night, 9 more people come than stayed until the end this time. How many people come?
How many fewer people came that night than on the first walk?

problem: How many guests left the outdoor movie early? It began with 28 guests on the lawn, but the wind got cold, and only 11 watched to the end.
follow_up_questions: At the next movie night, 9 more guests come than watched to the end this time. How many guests come?
How many fewer guests came then than at the first movie night?

problem: The tide came in after the sandcastle contest and washed away 7 castles in total. There had been 18 on the beach. How many sandcastles were still standing?
follow_up_questions: Kids build 5 new castles before sunset. How many are standing now?

problem: How many dominoes were still standing? Kai set up 18 dominoes in a row, but his cat bumped the table and in total 7 fell over.
follow_up_questions: Kai stands up 5 new dominoes. How many are standing now?

problem: The 3 groups at day camp took 15 beanbags out of the hall cupboard to play with on a hot afternoon. The cupboard had held 37. How many beanbags are still in it?
follow_up_questions: When playtime ends, the campers put 12 beanbags back. How many beanbags are in the cupboard now?

problem: How many paddles were left in the boathouse? It held 37 paddles, and the 3 rowing teams took 15 out on the lake.
follow_up_questions: After practice, the rowers return 12 paddles. How many paddles are in the boathouse now?

problem: A crane 38 metres tall stood at the harbour. A ship arrived with 72 containers on its deck, and now 27 are still on board. How many containers did the crane unload?
follow_up_questions: On Friday the crane unloads 19 more containers. How many containers are left on the deck?
How many containers has the crane unloaded from the ship in all?

problem: How many bricks did the builders carry up the 38 steps? There were 72 bricks at the bottom of the stairs, and 27 are still there.
follow_up_questions: On Friday they carry up 19 more bricks. How many bricks are left at the bottom?
How many bricks have they carried up in all?

problem: Elena cut 24 metres of ribbon for her dress, and Hugo cut 31 metres for his kite, both from the sewing class's 80-metre spool. The class meets in the old library. How many metres are left on the spool?
follow_up_questions: After a mistake, Elena needs 9 more metres. How many metres are left on the spool?
How many metres has Elena used in total?
How many more metres has Elena used than Hugo?

problem: How many stickers are left in the pack? The scrapbook club opened a pack of 80 stickers. Ming used 24 on his page and Farah used 31 on hers. Their pages are about summer holidays.
follow_up_questions: Ming spoils a page and needs 9 more stickers. How many are left in the pack?
How many stickers has Ming used in all?
How many more stickers has Ming used than Farah?

problem: Wrapping bouquets all morning, the florist used up 38 sheets of tissue paper, and her drawer now holds 21 sheets. Her shop has a yellow door. How many sheets were in the drawer when she opened?
follow_up_questions: In the afternoon she uses 12 more sheets. How many sheets are left?
A new pack of 45 sheets arrives. How many sheets does she have now?
How many sheets did she use during the whole day?

problem: How many tea bags were in the staff room box this morning? Teachers made 38 cups of tea before lunch, one tea bag each, and 21 bags are left. The staff room has a big green sofa.
follow_up_questions: After lunch they use 12 more tea bags. How many bags are left?
The head teacher brings a new box of 45 tea bags. How many bags are there now?
How many tea bags were used during the whole day?

problem: By the time the orchard was watered, 37 litres were left in the farmer's sprayer, which had started with 85 litres. How much water did he spray on the trees?
follow_up_questions: Back at the barn, he pumps 50 litres into the tank. How much water is in the tank now?

problem: How much fuel did the boat use on its trip around the island? It left the harbour with 85 litres in the tank and came back with 37.
follow_up_questions: At the dock the captain adds 50 litres. How much fuel is in the tank now?

problem: Only 11 of Abuela's 30 holiday tamales are left on the platter after her 4 grandchildren came in hungry. How many tamales did they eat?
follow_up_questions: Abuelo eats 3 tamales with his coffee. How many are left on the platter?
Abuela makes another 24 tamales. How many tamales are there now?

problem: How many dumplings did the swimmers eat? After practice, 4 swimmers ate dumplings from a plate of 30 that Coach Lin had made, and 11 are left.
follow_up_questions: Coach Lin eats 3 dumplings. How many are left on the plate?
She steams another 24. How many dumplings are there now?

problem: Every child who gets a haircut at Mr. Bello's shop takes one sticker from his box of 50. Today 17 children had haircuts. The shop has a spinning pole outside. How many stickers are left in the box?
follow_up_questions: Tomorrow 12 more children are booked for haircuts. How many stickers will be left after each one takes a sticker?

problem: How many pencil toppers are left in the jar? The school librarian started with 50 toppers and gave one to each of the 17 children who finished a book today. The library has a reading tent.
follow_up_questions: Tomorrow 12 more children will finish a book. How many toppers will be left once each of them gets one?

problem: After the members stuck 19 googly eyes onto their sock puppets, the craft club's box still had 15. How many googly eyes were in the box before?
follow_up_questions: They lose 2 eyes under the table. How many googly eyes are left in the box?

problem: How many beads were in the kit at first? Lina used 19 beads to make a bracelet for her mum, and 15 beads are left in the kit.
follow_up_questions: She drops 2 beads down the sink. How many beads are left in the kit?

problem: The shoe shop sold boots all week. It had ordered 96 pairs for winter, and on Saturday it had 9 pairs left. How many pairs were sold?
follow_up_questions: On Monday the shop gets another 48 pairs. How many pairs does it have then?
It sells 39 pairs that day. How many pairs are left?

problem: How many tickets did the theatre sell this week? It printed 96 tickets for the new show, and by Friday only 9 were left.
follow_up_questions: On Monday the theatre prints another 48 tickets. How many tickets does it have then?
It sells 39 tickets that day. How many are left?

problem: Groups painting posters took brushes from the art room cupboard, which held 45 altogether. Now 16 brushes are left in it. How many brushes did the groups take?
follow_up_questions: One group returns 5 brushes it did not need. How many brushes are in the cupboard now?
How many brushes do the groups still have?
The school buys 10 more brushes for the cupboard. How many brushes does the art room have now, counting the cupboard and the groups?

problem: How many tools did the gardeners take from the shed? Altogether the shed held 45 tools, and after the gardeners went out to work, 16 were left.
follow_up_questions: One gardener brings back 5 tools. How many tools are in the shed now?
How many tools are still out with the gardeners?
The park buys 10 new tools for the shed. Counting the shed and the gardeners, how many tools does the park have now?

problem: The library has a fish tank by the door. After Mr. Ade handed out 24 free comics from his basket to young readers, 16 were left in it. How many comics were in the basket to begin with?
follow_up_questions: He adds a pack of 25 comics. How many comics are in the basket now?

problem: How many ice packs were in the cooler at the start of the race? The first-aid team gave 24 ice packs to runners with sore legs, and 16 are left. The race ended at the beach.
follow_up_questions: The team adds a bag of 25 ice packs. How many ice packs are in the cooler now?

problem: Pavel's jar holds just 9 marbles now, a lot less than before, because he gave 13 to his friend at the playground. How many marbles did Pavel bring?
follow_up_questions: His friend gives back 4 marbles. How many marbles does Pavel have now?

problem: How many stickers did Aiko have before she gave 13 to her cousin? Her album now has 9 stickers, a lot less than before.
follow_up_questions: Her cousin gives her back 4 stickers. How many stickers does Aiko have now?

problem: In the end, 48 kids went on the music club's trip to the concert hall. Another 27 kids had signed up too but dropped out when the date moved. How many kids had signed up in total?
How many runners entered the fun run? Heavy rain kept 27 of them at home, and 48 runners crossed the finish line.
The heat reached 30 degrees, so neighbours borrowed fans from the community hall. The hall had 20 fans, and now 7 are left. How many fans were borrowed?
follow_up_questions: By evening, 8 fans are brought back. How many fans are in the hall now?
How many fans are still borrowed?

problem: How many umbrellas were borrowed from the hotel lobby? It rained for 30 minutes without stopping, and the lobby stand that held 20 umbrellas now holds 7.
follow_up_questions: When the rain stops, guests bring back 8 umbrellas. How many umbrellas are in the stand now?
How many umbrellas are still borrowed?

problem: A charity came to the school's book drive and took some books for its reading rooms, leaving 34 in the box. The drive had collected 88 used books. How many books did the charity take?
follow_up_questions: The charity finds that 19 of the books it took are too damaged to use. How many books can it use?
Families drop off 27 more books in the box. How many books are in the box now?
How many books has the drive collected in all?

problem: How many old bikes did the repair shop take? The bike drive gathered 88 bikes, and after the shop picked some up, 34 were left in the yard.
follow_up_questions: The shop says 19 of the bikes it took are too rusty to fix. How many bikes can be fixed?
People bring 27 more bikes to the yard. How many bikes are in the yard now?
How many bikes has the drive gathered altogether?

problem: A huge jug of lemonade for the hotel guests needed more lemons than usual. The kitchen had 36 lemons before the cook made it and 12 after. How many lemons went into the jug?
follow_up_questions: The cook uses 6 lemons for a cake. How many lemons are left?
A waiter buys a dozen lemons at the market. How many lemons does the kitchen have now?

problem: How many potatoes did Chef Bilal use? His kitchen had 36 potatoes this morning, and because the soup needed more potatoes than usual, only 12 were left at dinner time.
follow_up_questions: He uses 6 potatoes for chips. How many potatoes are left?
His helper brings a dozen potatoes from the garden. How many potatoes does the kitchen have now?

problem: At the ocean club's beach party, 14 of the 40 bags of gummy fish were left over at the end. Blue streamers hung from every tree. How many bags did the kids eat?
follow_up_questions: The leader gives 9 of the leftover bags to the swim team. How many bags does the ocean club have left?

problem: How many pizzas did the guests eat? For the class movie night, the teacher ordered 40 small pizzas, and 14 were not eaten. The movie was about a talking horse.
follow_up_questions: The teacher gives 9 leftover pizzas to the caretaker's family. How many leftover pizzas does she have now?

problem: There are still 15 paper crowns in the farm's box after 28 went home with children on school visits this week. Each visiting child gets a crown. The kids loved feeding the goats. How many crowns were in the box when the week began?
follow_up_questions: Next week 9 children visit, and each gets a crown. How many crowns are left in the box then?
The farmer orders 40 crowns. How many crowns are in the box now?
How many crowns have gone home with children over the two weeks?

problem: How many pins were in the museum's gift basket at the start of the week? Every child on a tour gets a free pin, and this week 28 pins were given away, leaving 15. The children loved the dinosaur room.
follow_up_questions: Next week 9 children come on a tour, and each takes a pin. How many pins are left in the basket then?
The museum orders 40 more pins. How many pins are in the basket now?
How many pins have children taken over the two weeks?

problem: The surf shop rented out 58 boards in total before noon. It had opened with 95 surfboards in its racks because the waves were big. How many boards were still in the racks at noon?
follow_up_questions: After lunch, 26 boards come back. How many boards are in the racks then?

problem: How many bikes were still at the rental stand at noon? It was a perfect sunny day; the stand had 95 bikes at opening time, and in total 58 were rented by noon.
follow_up_questions: In the afternoon, 26 bikes are returned. How many bikes are at the stand then?

problem: The dance contest still has 29 dancers in it this afternoon. Another 37 dancers were knocked out earlier and went home. How many dancers took part at the start?
follow_up_questions: In the next round, 13 more dancers are knocked out. How many are still in the contest?

problem: How many teams started the quiz night? After the first rounds, 37 teams were out of the game and 29 teams were still playing.
follow_up_questions: In the next round, 13 more teams are knocked out. How many teams are still playing?

problem: A pile of 60 bags of soil sits by the park gate. After the gardeners carried some to a new flower bed 9 metres long, 25 bags were left. How many bags did they carry?
follow_up_questions: A storm soaks and ruins 6 bags in the pile. How many good bags are left?
A truck brings 30 bags. How many bags are in the pile now?
How many bags were carried away or ruined by the storm?

problem: How many logs did the campers take from the woodpile? It had 60 logs, and after the campers built a big campfire next to their 9 tents, 25 logs were left.
follow_up_questions: Then 6 logs roll down into the creek. How many logs are left in the woodpile?
The ranger brings 30 logs. How many logs are in the woodpile now?
How many logs were taken by the campers or lost in the creek?

problem: The farmer gave 29 litres of water to the pigs and 19 litres to the hens from a tank that held 76 litres. How much water is still in the tank?
How many metres of rope are left on the reel? The sailing club had 76 metres of rope; members cut 29 metres for one boat and 19 metres for another.
The zoo shop sold 39 posters of its baby giraffe on Saturday. It had 75 of them that morning. The giraffe was born in the spring. How many giraffe posters are still for sale?
follow_up_questions: On Sunday, 17 more posters are sold. How many are left?
How many posters were sold over the weekend?

problem: How many bunches of sunflowers does the farm stall still have for sale? On Saturday it had 75 bunches and sold 39. Bees buzzed around the stall all day.
follow_up_questions: On Sunday, 17 more bunches are sold. How many bunches are left?
How many bunches were sold over the weekend?

problem: Kalani has 23 pieces of sea glass left after giving 12 to his sister. How many pieces did he find on the beach?
How many leaves did Freya gather for her school project? She gave 12 of them to a classmate and kept 23.
To thank the neighbours who found his lost dog, Mr. Brandt put out a tray of sandwiches. Only 5 were left after the neighbours ate 11. How many sandwiches had he made?
How many muffins did Aunt Maya bake for the team? The players ate 11 after the game, and 5 muffins were left in the box.
There are 8 free newspapers left on the station stand after travellers took 33 today. How many were on the stand when the day began?
How many bunches of bananas were in the market crate this morning? Today shoppers took 33 bunches, and 8 bunches are still in the crate.
Painters bought cans of paint for a house. They used 45 cans on the outside walls and 28 cans on the inside walls, and 14 cans are left. How many cans did they buy?
follow_up_questions: They need 30 cans for the fence. How many more cans must they buy?
Once the fence is painted, how many cans have they used in all for the outside walls, the inside walls and the fence?
How many more cans went on the outside walls than on the inside walls?

problem: How many paving stones were in the pile at first? Builders used 45 stones for the patio and 28 for the path, and they have 14 stones left over.
follow_up_questions: The garden wall needs 30 stones. How many more stones must they buy?
When the wall is done, how many stones have they used altogether on the patio, the path and the wall?
How many more stones went into the patio than into the path?
